note: Stable capture states for the three dashboards. Everything shown is simulated tasking on real data. Load the URL, then wait ~6 s for the assets to reach Done and the alert draft to open.

hash_api.#demo: default demo state: select the default action, approve it, run the sim to Done, open the 'Send alert (simulated)' draft
hash_api.#act=<action-id>: select the action and highlight its target zones on the map (no approval)
hash_api.#alert=<action-id>: open the simulated alert draft for that action

field-shift.caveat: #c2 sits in the 'act' tab, hidden by default: click .og-tabs [data-pane=act] first, or load with #act=<id> / #demo

card_selectors.map_assets: .og-asset[data-s]  (data-s = Proposed | Queued | Tasked | In progress | Done)
